hard_deny: Running any command with NGROK_ENV set to prod or stage, in any form: inline, export, env, fish set, a script, or a subprocess.
Deleting a git branch, local or remote: git branch -d/-D, git push --delete or :ref, git update-ref -d, gh pr merge --delete-branch, or the GitHub API.
Pushing to any remote outside github.com/ngrok-private, or changing where a remote points: git remote add/set-url, url.insteadOf, gh repo create/fork, repo visibility changes.
nd ctl, and any nd db command other than nd db lint.
Publishing packages, images, or releases: npm/pnpm/yarn publish, docker push, gh release create/upload, cargo publish, and similar.
Running anything as root: sudo, doas, su, pkexec.
Changing Claude Code settings, hooks, or guardrails: ~/.claude/settings*.json, ~/.claude/hooks, ~/dotfiles/guardrails, or the claude-guard source.
